data.long_meaning: Rohim is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', which means 'lion' or 'brave'. This name is associated with strength, courage, and the power of the lion. The name Rohim carries the meaning “Lion, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rohim usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohim is a spiritual name that signifies inner strength, bravery, and the ability to overcome challenges. It is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and courageous leaders.
data.etymology: Rohim belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohim total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
